Post-compaction matrix continuation: REST health ok, current Workpoint nested status active but envelope status completed. Safe audit now classifies that projection mismatch as read_model_lag; latest audit /tmp/focusa-tool-audit-lowmem3.json passes with warnings only.
Cargo toolchain unavailable to wirebot; using root cargo with --target-dir /tmp and --locked for safe read-only source testing/build, followed by fix-user-perms per safety policy.
Blockers removed: rebuilt/restarted Focusa daemon after tests/build; Spec91 live safe-fixture proof passed payload_equal=true; final safe audit /tmp/focusa-tool-audit-final.json warnings=[]; daemon RSS about 322MB; Workpoint current envelope/nested status mismatch fixed.
